front.title: Transmission of IPv6 Packets over Controller Area Network

abstract.t: Controller Area Network (CAN) is a fieldbus initially designed for automotive applications. It has since been adopted for use in various industrial applications, such as CANopen and building automation systems. CAN operates as a multi-master bus with frame identifiers of 11 bits or 29 bits. The CAN standard, defined in the ISO 11898 series, specifies both the physical and data-link layers. This document describes how to transfer IPv6 packets over CAN using ISO-TP, a dedicated addressing scheme for CAN nodes, and IP header compression (IPHC).
